Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 Must be the first field in the message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following BodyLength field up to and including the de- limiter preceding the CheckSum (10) field. Must be the second field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be the third field in the message.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a message resent from the admin level (has a duplicate sequence number). Defaults to N.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender. Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (TargetCompID (56) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: GMT date and time that message was sent. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination. CEDX for messages sent to CEDX ports. (SenderCompID (49) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination. TEST for messages sent to the Cboe test system. PROD for messages sent to the Cboe production system. (SenderSubID (50) for messages from Cboe.)

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Possible resend flag. Cboe has special handling for the PossResend for New Order Single messages. See New Order — Single below.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on messages to Cboe. Must be identifier known to Cboe. May be used by non-service bureau to specify which clearing arrangement to use if multiple are configured.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: End-client sub identifier. Four characters, alphanumeric, otherwise not validated. Recorded and re- turned in DeliverToSubID (129). Available via Drop.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with PossDupFlag (43) = Y, indicates time that message was first sent. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on message from Cboe. Must be Cboe approved identifier.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Returns OnBehalfOfSubID (116) optionally sent by client.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in the message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional. Returned on execution reports associated with this order. 16 characters or less (ASCII 33–126). The value supplied can be passed to the CCP and made available on the Drop feed.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. A leading tilde(˜) cannot be sent on any ClOrdID and will result in a reject. These are reserved for internal use by Cboe and could be received as a result of a system-generated ClOrdID. If the ClOrdID matches a live order, it will be rejected as duplicate (unless PossResend (97) = Y; see above). Note: Cboe only enforces the uniqueness of ClOrdID values among currently live orders. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your ClOrdID values day unique.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by Cboe: 4 = ISIN Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts for order, 1 to 999,999.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market 2 = Limit 3 = Stop (Options only) 4 = Stop Limit Market (1) implies TimeInForce (59) = 3 (IOC). Stop/Stop Limit orders must have TimeInForce (59) = 0 (DAY), 1 (GTC), or 6 (GTD).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: A = Agency (maps to ’AOTC’) P = Principal (maps to ’DEAL’) R = Riskless (maps to ’MTCH’)

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 4) for additional notes.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 = Day (Default) - Expires at the end of market day. 1 = GTC (allowed, but treated as Day) 2 = At the Open. Will remain queued and only interact in the Opening process. 3 = IOC 4 = FOK 6 = GTD (expires at earlier of specified ExpireTime (126) or end of day)

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time order initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2 but not used by Cboe. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Indicates status of client position. O = Open C = Close N = None Orders wtih AccountType (581) = 3 (House Trader) are not required to specify OpenClose or may optionally specify a value of “N”. Otherwise, or- ders with AccountType (581) = 1 (Customer Account) must specify Open- Close.

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: The trigger price for Stop (Options only) and Stop Limit orders. Required if OrdType (40) = 3 or 4.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Optional minimum1 fill quantity for IOC orders. Ignored for other orders. Default is zero.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Required for TimeInForce (59) = 6 (GTD) orders, specifies the date and time (in GMT) that the order expires.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Firm that will clear trade. Optional. Note: shares storage with OnBehal- fOfCompID (115). If both fields are set, they must be equal.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Supplemental identifier. Optional. Recorded and returned in execution reports. Available via Drop. Note: shares storage with OnBehalfOfSubID (116). If both fields are set, then OnBehalfOfSubID (116) takes precedence for Service Bureau connections and ClearingAccount takes precedence for other connections.

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Type of account associated with the order 1 = Account is carried on customer side of the books. 3 = House Trader This field is required.

Field.Name: CustOrderHandlingInst
Field.Description: Indicates the Execution Source Code on orders prior to their executions. Mandatory. A default value can be set using the ’Default Customer Order Handling Instruction’ port attribute. The port attribute is defaulted to Y (Electronic). Y = Electronic. (Default) W = Desk C = Vendor-provided Platform billed by Executing Broker (For complex) G = Sponsored Access via Exchange API or FIX provided by Executing Broker (For complex) H = Premium Algorithmic Trading Provider billed by Executing Broker (For complex) D = Other, including Other-provided screen (For complex)

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: 5 = DEA. Indicate DEA activity (as defined by MiFID II) is involved in the order. 0 = Non-DEA. (default) Other values are unsupported and will be rejected.

Field.Name: DrillThruProtection
Field.Description: Amount sender is willing to trade through BBO at the time of order en- try. This is avaialble for both futures and options on simple and complex instruments. The amount should be entered as a non-negative value indicating he pro- tection to be applied for the order. This is the value by which the order may aggress the resting BBO. The drill through price is then the resting BBO aggressed by the drill through protection value. A zero value denotes full BBO protection. This will allow the inbound order to execute only against the top level of the resting price. The drill through price is the resting BBO. If unspecified, the exchange default value will be used. The drill through price is the resting BBO aggressed by the exchange default value.

Field.Name: RiskReset
Field.Description: For use by participants using Cboe Risk Management tools to reset or release Trading Firm, Trading Firm Group, Symbol or CustomGroupID level lockout conditions resulting from risk profile trips or self-imposed lockout issued via Order Cancel Request or Purge Request message. Single Character Values - with counter reset: S = Symbol level lockout reset F = Trading firm level lockout reset C = CustomGroupID lockout reset G = Trading firm Group level lockout reset Single Character Values - without counter reset: T = Symbol level self-imposed lockout reset E = Trading firm level self-imposed lockout reset D = CustomGroupID self-imposed lockout reset H = Trading firm Group level lockout reset Values may be combined together to allow for resets of multiple self-imposed lockouts in a single message. For example, FS, SC, FC, and SFC are all acceptable values. The single character values with no counter reset will release a self-imposed lockout condition only without resetting any counters related to active risk rules. This may be useful for time based risk rules where the lockout may be released without resetting any risk values being tracked back to zero. If a conflicting value is provided the lockout release with counter reset will take precedence. For example, “ST” will release any lockout and reset any applicable root-level rule counters to zero. When a resting or inbound order is executed and a Symbol level risk profile limit is reached, resting orders on the associated Product Code will be can- celled and inbound orders on the Product Code will be rejected until this field is filled with the value S on a subsequent New Order or New Com- plex Order message corresponding to a symbol on the same Product Code, or on a Reset Risk message. If a Trading Firm level rule is tripped, this tag can be filled with the value F to reset all Trading Firm level rules. While this will reset Trading Firm level rules, it is possible that both Trading Firm and Symbol level rules are currently both tripped. Setting this field to F will not clear Symbol level rules and the order may still be rejected. To clear both Symbol and Trading Firm level rules, set this field to SF to reset all associated Trading Firm level and Symbol level lockouts. If orders have been locked out by at the custom group ID level, inbound orders for the locked custom group ID will be rejected until this field is filled with the value C.

Field.Name: CustomGroupID
Field.Description: Custom identifier for a group of orders.

Field.Name: PreventParticipantMatch
Field.Description: Participant Trade Prevention: 3 characters (not space separated). See Participant Trade Prevention (p. 5) for allowed values and explanations.

Field.Name: OrderAttributeTypes
Field.Description: Optional. This FIX tag can contain multiple values. If more than one value is present, they must be separated by spaces. The presence of a value means, for example, the order is an algorithmic order. The absence of a value indicates otherwise. Cboe supports the following values: 2 = Liquidity Provision activity order. This indicates the order is related to any sort of liquidity provision activity, as defined by MiFID II. This flag is mandatory for orders which are part of a liquidity provision activity. Absence of this value indicates otherwise. 4 = Algorithmic order. This indicates that the order was placed as a result of an investment firm engaging in algorithmic trading. Absence of this value indicates otherwise.

Otherwise, or- ders with AccountType (581) = 1 (Customer Account) must specify Open- Close.

Field.Name: MassCancelInst
Field.Description: At least one character must be provided (Trading Firm Filter). Contiguous characters must be specified up to total length. Truncated (unspecified) characters will default to values indicated below. 1st Character : Trading firm Filter A = No filtering by trading firm is performed. F = All orders that were sent under the trading firm specified in OnBehal- fOfCompId (115) will be cancelled. If “F” specified and OnBehalfOf- CompId (115) is not provided, the Mass Cancel will be rejected. 2nd Character : Acknowledgement Style M = (Default) Individual Execution Reports are sent for each cancelled order. S = Single summary Execution Report sent once all cancels have been pro- cessed. Single summary Execution Report will contain MassCancelId (7695) and CancelledOrderCount (7696). MassCancelId (7695) must be specified or the Mass Cancel will be rejected. B = Both individual Execution Reports and single summary Execution Re- port. Also requires MassCancelId (7695) to be specified or the Mass Cancel will be rejected. 3rd Character : Lockout Instruction N = (Default) No lockout L = Lockout until corresponding Risk Reset received. Lockout can be used only with clearing firm Filter set to F, otherwise the Mass Cancel will be rejected. Lockout will apply to all new orders and cancel/replace or- ders for the clearing firm (and Symbol (55) or CustomGroupId (7699), if specified). 4th Character : Instrument Type Filter B = (Default) Cancel both Simple and Complex orders S = Cancel Simple orders only C = Cancel Complex orders only If Symbol (55) is specified, it must contain a valid underlying symbol, in which case only orders underlying on that symbol will be cancelled. A self-imposed lockout can be released using the RiskReset (7692) field of the New Order Single message. If Symbol (55) is not specified and zero CustomGroupId (7699) are specified, a Clearing Firm level reset is required. If Symbol (55) is specified, a Symbol level reset is required. If one or more CustomGroupId (7699) values are provided, a CustomGroupID level reset is required.

Field.Name: MassCancelID
Field.Description: This field will be echoed back in the resulting Execution Report when the second character of MassCancelInst (7700) is set to ”S” or ”B”. Mass Cancel containing a MassCancelID that is currently outstanding will be rejected.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional. Returned on execution reports associated with this order. 16 characters or less (ASCII 33–126). The value supplied can be passed to the CCP and made available on the Drop feed.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. If the ClOrdID matches a live order, it will be rejected as duplicate (unless PossResend (97) = Y; see above). Note: Cboe only enforces the uniqueness of ClOrdID values among currently live orders. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your ClOrdID values day unique.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by Cboe: 4 = ISIN Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order identifier supplied by Cboe on the order acknowledgement. In the case of multiple changes to a single order, this should be the OrderID from the most recent acknowledgement.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares for the order. This will modify the OrderQty of the current order, it does not directly set the remaining quantity.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market 2 = Limit 3 = Stop (Options only) 4 = Stop Limit May replace Limit with Market. It may also replace Stop with Stop Limit and vice versa, but otherwise must match original order, if sent.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order to replace. In the case of multiple changes to a single order, this will be the ClOrdID of the most recently accepted change.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 4) for additional notes.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time cancel/replace initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2 but not used by Cboe. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Ignored - value preserved from original order

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Optional. Defaults to original order if not set.

Field.Name: CancelOrigOnReject
Field.Description: N = Leave original order alone (default) Y = Cancel original order if replacement fails Default may be configured per port.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present. (Available on Drop via optional port config- uration)

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Average fill price.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order being accepted, executed, or rejected. –or– ClOrdID of the cancel or replace request. –or– ClOrdID of the order subject to unsolicited cancel (OrigClOrdID (41) will not be present).

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Cumulative quantity of contracts (or complex instruments) executed for this order over the life of the order.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID of execution message.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 0 = New 3 = Status

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: LastCapacity
Field.Description: Broker capacity in order execution. 1 = Agent (maps to ’AOTC’) 3 = Cross as Principal (maps to ’MTCH’) 4 = Principal (maps to ’DEAL’)

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Populated with the segment MIC of this fill.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill (zero for non-fills).

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of contracts (or complex instruments) traded on this fill (zero for non-fills).

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order identifier supplied by Cboe.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: State of order. 0 = New 1 = Partially Filled 2 = Filled 4 = Canceled 5 = Replaced 6 = Pending Cancel 8 = Rejected A = Pending Ack E = Pending Replace

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order being canceled or replaced (for a solicited cancel or cancel/replace, otherwise not present).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Copied from order or trade report.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If present, indicates reason for the message. Format is one letter reason code followed by colon and space followed by free form text message. See Reason Codes (§ 12.1, p. 74) for a list of possible reasons.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time transaction occurred. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Optionally set when ExecType (150) = 8 (Rejected). 0 = Broker Option 1 = Unknown Symbol 2 = Exchange Closed 3 = Order Exceeds Limit 5 = Unknown Order 6 = Duplicate Order 8 = Stale Order

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Copied from order if TimeInForce (59) = 6 (GTD).

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Reason for this execution report. 0 = New (acknowledgement of new order) 1 = Partial Fill 2 = Fill 4 = Canceled 5 = Replaced 8 = Rejected D = Restated M = Mass Cancel Complete For Drop only, if optionally configured, the following value is also supported: F = Trade When responding to a Mass Cancel request, ExecType (150) is set to a value of “M”. This indicates the only tags present in this message are the following:

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity of shares still open for further execution. Will be zero if order is dead, otherwise will be OrderQty − CumQty. Note: It is possible for LeavesQty to be zero when ExecType (150) = 5 indicating that the order is dead.

Field.Name: SecondaryOrderID
Field.Description: Must request opt-in at firm or port level to receive this field. Present on Prevent Participant Match triggered cancel/restatement. De- notes the Cboe OrderID (37) of contra side of prevented match. Present on a restatement execution report for reload of a reserve (iceberg) order. Denotes the new Cboe OrderID which will be present on the Cboe market data feeds.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Only present on trades. Indicates the market of execution, always CEDX. Markets are identified by their ISO Market Identification Code (MIC)2

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Required when ExecType (150) = D (Restated). 4 = Set when an aggressively held order is released to the Order Book. The reason is also indicated in Text (58). For Cboe Europe Derivatives, this is currently the only reason restatements are sent.

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only present on trades. Always 1.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: MultilegReportingType
Field.Description: 1 = Single-leg / Simple instrument execution 2 = Individual leg of a multi-leg instrument (Options), or Simple instrument execution that is part of a Spread instrument execution (Futures) 3 = Multileg / Spread Instrument execution

Field.Name: SecondaryExecID
Field.Description: Field indicates whether a fill or partial fill ExecType (150) = 1 or 2) is a complex / Spread instrument fill or a single-leg / simple instrument fill that comprises a complex / Spread execution. If SecondaryExecID (527) is not present, the fill is a single- leg / simple instrument fill only. If SecondaryExecID (527) is present and is the same as the ExecID (17), the fill represents a complex / Spread execution for which associated single-leg / simple instrument fills will follow. Single-leg / Simple instrument fills associated with a complex / spread ex- ecution will contain a SecondaryExecID (527) of the associated complex / Spread execution.

Field.Name: CrossID
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: CrossType
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: CrossPrioritization
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: CustOrderHandlingInst
Field.Description: Copied from order, if present.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: 5 = DEA. Indicate DEA activity (as defined by MiFID II) is involved in the order. 0 = Non-DEA. (default) Other values are unsupported and will be rejected.

Field.Name: DrillThruProtection
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: CrossExclusionIndicator
Field.Description: N = Contracts were executed in auction against contra party, or against a resting order when auction was initiated. Y = Contracts were executed in auction against another party.

Field.Name: MassCancelID
Field.Description: Copied from the incoming Mass Cancel.

Field.Name: CancelledOrderCount
Field.Description: Number of orders cancelled from a Purge Request with the specified Mass- CancelID

Field.Name: CentralCounterparty
Field.Description: Only present on trades. The CCP handling the trade: ECCP = European Central Counterparty EuroCCP NONE = Clearing Suppressed Returned on trades if the participant has selected a Preferred CCP. The FIX port can be configured to always return this optional field.

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationReasons
Field.Description: If present, indicates the post-trade waiver derived by Cboe for this trade. Valid values are: 4 = Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver for Illiquid Instrument (for SI only) (ILQD) 5 = Pre-Trade Transparency Waiver for Above Standard Market Size (for SI only) (SIZE) Pre-Trade Transparency Waivers ILQD and SIZE can be requested individu- ally or together by specifying one ore more value separated by a space (e.g. 4 5). Based upon what is requested, the system calculates which of these are valid. The business confirmation contains the waiver(s) that have been appplied.

Field.Name: OrderAttributeTypes
Field.Description: Optional. This FIX tag can contain multiple values. If more than one value is present, they must be separated by spaces. The presence of a value means, for example, the order is an algorithmic order. The absence of a value indicates otherwise. Cboe supports the following values: 2 = Liquidity Provision activity order. This indicates the order is related to any sort of liquidity provision activity, as defined by MiFID II. This flag is mandatory for orders which are part of a liquidity provision activity. Absence of this value indicates otherwise. 4 = Algorithmic order. This indicates that the order was placed as a result of an investment firm engaging in algorithmic trading. Absence of this value indicates otherwise.

Field.Name: RoutingInst
Field.Description: Copied from order.

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: For Options only: Exposed order identifier supplied by Cboe. This identifier corresponds to the identifiers used in Cboe market data products.

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Present for acknowledgements (150=0) and fills (150=1 or 150=2). For cross orders, present for fills only. Can be requested opt-in port level for restatements following the release of aggressively held orders. 1st Character A = Added Liquidity R = Removed Liquidity C = Auction 2nd Character b = Automated Improvement Mechanism (AIM) U = Qualifying Market Turner order. Only set when the order added liq- uidity. g = Aggressive Hold. Order held by speed bump. Must request opt-in port level to receive the 2nd characters in this field. The 2nd character will be absent if none of them applies. To allow for future expansion of this field, please ignore values with an unknown character in the 2nd position.

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Specific fee code associated with the trade. See the Fee Schedule for the respective market for possible values.

Field.Name: SubreasonText
Field.Description: If present, indicates addition detail for the reject or cancel. Format is one letter code followed by colon and space followed by free form text. See Subreason Codes (§ 12.2, p. 75) for a list of possible reasons.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Copied from Cancel or Cancel/Replace request.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID from the Cancel or Cancel/Replace request.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: OrderID of the order that failed to be canceled or replaced. NONE if CxlRejReason (102) = 1 (Unknown Order).

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: State of order that failed to be canceled or replaced.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order that failed to be canceled or replaced.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free-form text message.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: 0 = Too Late to Cancel 1 = Unknown Order 3 = Already Pending Cancel or Pending Replace

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: 1 = Cancel 2 = Cancel/Replace

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order whose trade is being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID of execution message.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Refers to the ExecID (17) of the execution being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 1 = Cancel 2 = Correct

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Copied from order being canceled or corrected, if present.

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: LastMkt on the original trade being canceled or corrected, if the port is configured to send this tag.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price on the original trade being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of contracts on the original trade being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: OrderID of the order whose trade is being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: OrigTime
Field.Description: Date and time of the original trade, in GMT. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Copied from original order being canceled or corrected if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN) was used.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Copied from trade being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Copied from original order being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Date and time of the cancel or correction. Microsecond level resolution.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Copied from original trade being cancelled/corected.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Copied from trade being canceled or corrected, if present.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Copied from trade being canceled or corrected, if present.

Field.Name: SettlPrice
Field.Description: Drop only. SettlPrice on the original trade being canceled or corrected, if relevant.

Field.Name: CorrectedSize
Field.Description: The corrected size of the trade. Only set if ExecTransType (20) = 2 (Trade Correct).

Field.Name: CorrectedPrice
Field.Description: The corrected price of the trade. Only set if ExecTransType (20) = 2 (Trade Correct).

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Copied from trade being canceled or corrected.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID from the Security Definition Request.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Cboe Symbol ID of created instrument.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free form text message.

Field.Name: SecurityResponseType
Field.Description: 1 = Accept As-Is (legs were not modified) 2 = Accept With Revisions (legs were modified) 5 = Reject Security Proposal Accept As-Is only applies if the input legs matches exactly the complex security definition. Any re-ordering of legs, reduction of ratios, or other changes will result in a value of Accept with Revisions.

Field.Name: NoOfSecurities
Field.Description: NUmber of complex strategies created by sender for this underlying.

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: The short code representing the client or decision maker represented by this block. Unsigned numerical only. Data corresponding to this short code must have been previously supplied, or will be supplied by the end of the calendar day, per our Rules. For clients, the following values are reserved for applicable use: Applicable to PartyRole value 3: 0 = NONE (No Client for this order) 1 = AGGR (An aggregation of multiple client orders) 2 = PNAL (Clients are pending allocation) Applicable to PartyRole value 12: 3 = NORE (Timing and location of the execution determined by the client of the Participant)

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: Must always be P (Short code identifier)

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Specifies the role of the party to the trade. At this time, only the following values are valid: 3 = Client ID 12 = Executing Trader (the Executing Decision Maker) 122 = Investor ID (the Investment Decision Maker)

Field.Name: PartyRoleQualifier
Field.Description: Provides further qualification of the PartyRole value. Valid values are: 0 = None (applicable only for the reserved Party IDs) 22 = Algorithm (applicable to PartyRole values 12 or 122) 23 = Firm or legal entity (LEI) (applicable to PartyRole value 3) 24 = Natural person (applicable to PartyRole values 3, 12 and 122)

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Required tag to start each repeated group. 1 = Buy 2 = Sell

Field.Name: PreventParticipantMatch
Field.Description: Participant Trade Prevention: 3 characters (not space separated). See Participant Trade Prevention (p. 5) for allowed values and expla- nations. PTP instructions on the AIM order will be used to prevent executions against AIM responses only; executions against resting or unrelated orders will still be permitted. Responses may only employ ”Cancel Newest”, in which case the response will be cancelled and the auction order will continue. Valid for Agency Side only. Ignored on Contra Side.

Field.Name: AllocQty
Field.Description: Required tag to start each repeated group. Number of contracts for this party.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional. Returned on execution reports associated with this order. 16 characters or less (ASCII 33–126). The value supplied can be passed to the CCP and made available on the Drop feed.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: A = Agency (maps to ’AOTC’) P = Principal (maps to ’DEAL’) R = Riskless (maps to ’MTCH’)

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Indicates status of client position. O = Open C = Close N = None Orders wtih AccountType (581) = 3 (House Trader) are not required to specify OpenClose or may optionally specify a value of “N”. Other- wise, orders with AccountType (581) = 1 (Customer Account) must specify OpenClose.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Firm that will clear trade.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Supplemental identifier. Optional. Recorded and returned in execu- tion reports. Available via Drop.

Field.Name: AccountType
Field.Description: Type of account associated with the order 1 = Account is carried on customer side of the books. 3 = House Trader This field is required.

Field.Name: OrderOrigination
Field.Description: 5 = DEA. Indicate DEA activity (as defined by MiFID II) is involved in the order. 0 = Non-DEA. (default) Other values are unsupported and will be rejected.

Field.Name: CustOrderHandlingInst
Field.Description: Indicates the Execution Source Code on orders prior to their exe- cutions. Mandatory. A default value can be set using the ’Default Customer Order Handling Instruction’ port attribute. The port at- tribute is defaulted to Y (Electronic). Y = Electronic. (Default) W = Desk C = Vendor-provided Platform billed by Executing Broker (For com- plex) G = Sponsored Access via Exchange API or FIX provided by Exe- cuting Broker (For complex) H = Premium Algorithmic Trading Provider billed by Executing Bro- ker (For complex) D = Other, including Other-provided screen (For complex)

Field.Name: OrderAttributeTypes
Field.Description: Optional. This FIX tag can contain multiple values. If more than one value is present, they must be separated by spaces. The presence of a value means, for example, the order is an algorithmic order. The absence of a value indicates otherwise. Cboe supports the following values: 2 = Liquidity Provision activity order. This indicates the order is related to any sort of liquidity provision activity, as defined by MiFID II. This flag is mandatory for orders which are part of a liquidity provision activity. Absence of this value indicates otherwise. 4 = Algorithmic order. This indicates that the order was placed as a result of an investment firm engaging in algorithmic trading. Absence of this value indicates otherwise.

Field.Name: LegPositionEffects
Field.Description: A string of position effects with one value per leg. For example, if five legs, then this field must have five position effects specified. Ordering of position effects matches the order specified in LegRefID (654) repeating group (below), or the instrument definition if using a short form request. O = Open C = Close N = None Orders wtih AccountType (581) = 3 (House Trader) are not required to specify LegPositionEffects or may specify a value of “N” for the leg. Otherwise, orders with AccountType (581) = 1 (Customer Ac- count) must specify LegPositionEffects.

Field.Name: LegRefID
Field.Description: Required tag to start each repeated group. Leg ID chosen by client. Five or fewer alphanumeric characters.

Field.Name: LegSymbol
Field.Description: Cboe Symbology Symbol. Not required for short form requests

Field.Name: LegRatioQty
Field.Description: Ratio of number of contracts in this leg per order quantity. All legs must be reduced (i.e. 2:2 must be sent as 1:1) in order to be accepted by the system when using this message type. Accepted values are 1 - 99,999. Not required for short form requests

Field.Name: LegSide
Field.Description: Side is from the Agency side’s perspective: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell Not required for short form requests

Field.Name: LegPrice
Field.Description: Reference price for the future leg of a Volatility Strategy. Mandatory for this case, otherwise ignored. See the Volatility Strategies section (p. 6) for more details. Not required for short form requests

Field.Name: LegPositionEffect
Field.Description: Indicates status of client position in option for this leg. O = Open C = Close N = None Orders wtih AccountType (581) = 3 (House Trader) may specify a value of “N”. House Trader only needs to specify this if NoLegs (555) is set to a non-zero value. For orders with AccountType (581) = 1 (Customer Account), LegPositionEffect must be specified with a valid value for each leg.

Field.Name: AffectedOrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the Agency / Contra sides of a AIM rejected order. Must request opt-in at firm or port level to receive this field.
